hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||"";process.stdout.write(f);}catch(e){}});'); rel="${f#$PWD/}"; case "$rel" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx --yes prettier --write "$rel";; *.cs) dotnet format backend/MobileShop.sln --include "$rel";; esac 2>/dev/null || true

$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $msg = if ($j.message) { $j.message } else { "Claude Code needs your attention" }; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; $n.ShowBalloonTip(4000, "Claude Code", $msg, [System.Windows.Forms.ToolTipIcon]::Info); Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $n.Dispose()
echo "Backend: .NET API in /backend. Frontend: React apps in /frontend/public-site and /frontend/admin-panel. Run dotnet test before commits, and npm run build before pushing frontend changes."
